summary: Completed live backend and frontend smoke testing for the Claims & Coverage Companion prototype.
action_items: Replace the seeded dashboard response with authenticated persistent household/claim storage in a future iteration.
Implement supporting module content/routes when Policies, Evidence, and Documents move beyond navigation intent.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard data and all claim actions are intentionally seeded/prototype-only; no real authentication, storage, insurer, document upload, or AI integration is present.
Navigation currently changes active state but does not render separate module content, which is acceptable for the requested prototype intent but should be revisited for production.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created; verified existing seeded dashboard payload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live preview https://policy-shield-8.preview.emergentagent.com tested. GET /api/dashboard, GET /api/status, and GET /api/ all returned 200. Desktop and 390px mobile browser pass: workspace content, modal cashless/reimbursement toasts, navigation active states, notification/support/upload/household feedback, review scroll, and no horizontal overflow.
rca of the issue: No defects reproduced. Prototype limitations are architectural scope items rather than failures: dashboard is a static API payload and UI fallback; action buttons provide toast feedback without persistence or external integrations.
